How Much Is a Beer in NYC? Pint Prices in New York (2026)

Expect to pay about $9 for a 16 oz draft in Manhattan in 2026, against a US average of $6.52. Happy hour brings that down to around $6. Here's what we found across more than 60 New York bars.

By the ontap team · 22 October 2026

NYC beer prices at a glance

Price (16 oz)Source

Watch the size: a lot of New York "pints" are 16 oz, some are 14 oz, and plenty of cheap deals are 12 oz cans. Our price per pint calculator makes it a fair fight.

Tips for drinking in NYC without the $12 pint

  • Happy hours (usually 4–7pm) are where the deals are, especially at sports bars and dives.
  • Outer-borough bars, especially in Brooklyn and Queens, usually beat Manhattan by a couple of dollars.
  • Domestic lagers and house beers are cheapest; IPAs and imports usually add $2–4.
  • Remember tax and tip: menu prices don't include the roughly $1–2 tip per drink.

How we got these numbers

In October 2026 we collected over 60 New York beer prices from bar menus and recent guides, recorded the size, source and date for each, and counted happy hour separately.

FAQ

How much is a beer in NYC?

Around $9 for a 16 oz draft in Manhattan in 2026 (VinePair measured $9.16), less in Brooklyn and Queens, and about $6 at happy hour.

Is New York the most expensive US city for beer?

VinePair's 2026 report named New York (Manhattan) the most expensive beer city in the US.

Do I need to tip on beer in New York?

Yes, $1–2 per drink at the bar is standard.
